title: EAGLE FINANCIAL SERVICES, INC. ANNOUNCES 2026 SECOND QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS AND QUARTERLY DIVIDEND
summary: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. (NASDAQ: EFSI) (the "Company"), the holding company for Bank of Clarke, announced its second quarter 2026 results. Also, on July 23, 2026, the Board of Directors announced a quarterly common stock cash dividend of $0.31 per common share, payable on August 14, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 3, 2026.
